descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S25 Real camera photo of a printed supervisor list on Android and iOS, against the local stack

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)
  • U7 New residents, whether added by photo or by hand, land in All Residents as Follow-up (TC-06 defaults). (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-06 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 5; TFA-92587 How it works 5)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given The Android debug build of main bundled for the local stack, on the emulator or a USB phone with adb reverse on 4510/4511 as in scripts/android-lane.ts; an iOS simulator or local Xcode build pointed at the local stack. Never the TestFlight or Play review builds: they point at the dev deployment. …

When Photograph the printed supervisor-day1 sheet with the camera at a slight angle, under ward-like light, from the Nursing Home scan control (Android); on iOS choose an iPhone photo (HEIC) of the same sheet from the library

Then The camera opens from the scan control, and the HEIC photo is read. The same 2 known / 2 new result as S04, and the same Today's Visits and All Residents outcome

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): A tester compares the device's scan sheet, Today's Visits and All Residents with S04's expected outcome. A camera run on a physical iPhone cannot reach 127.0.0.1:4510; it would need the dev backend (needs-dev-or-prod) and Quinn's explicit approval first, so it is not part of this scenario

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
